title: Location
description: Original user-supplied location vs validated (possibly offshore-snapped) analysis location. §13.3, §20.1, §99.1

original.description: As supplied by the user — coordinate and/or place name, before validation or snapping.

validated.description: The input coordinate if valid marine, or the snapped offshore coordinate. Centre of the sampling grid. §13.3, §15

snapped.description: True if this coordinate was moved offshore from a coastal land point. §13.3

snap_distance_km.description: Distance from original to snapped point, when snapped=true.

snap_reference.description: Human-readable reference used in the snap explanation, e.g. 'east of Marina Beach'.
